review.title: Amsterdam gut panel: six reference correspondences and three preserved ambiguity sets
review.independence_basis: A peer independently read both complete records, primary stock passages, source plans, historical guards and the frozen source configurations. The same peer separately read the exact actual Amsterdam candidate and receipt before application, rehashing all 31 staged inputs. The parent authorized that accepted bounded correction. The shared native engine, checker, builder and exporter have separate reviews and mutation controls. This is self-review of the technical correspondence correction, not an independent full scientific assessment.
review.summary: Nine existing taxonomy descriptors now have six native reference blocks with GROUNDED status and three complete ordered ambiguity sets with AMBIGUOUS status. The unselected Lachnospiraceae bacterium DSM 24404 remains UNRESOLVED. All ten DSM stocks, original notes and source quotations, one community-level conditioned-medium node, absent participants, zero arrows and earlier history remain unchanged. The reference populations do not establish stock genomes or resolve the record's scientific findings.
review.scope_description: CommunityMech:000382 taxonomy indices 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 9: six correspondence blocks, three complete ambiguity sets, nine changed statuses and two actual native inline events, with guarded application, appended native sidecar and eight scoped native checks. Index 7 and all biological content are preserved.
review.selection: The first complete whole-record canary in the separately prepared 382/466 pair. The reviewed population is exactly one record; the second record is not applied or assessed by this diagnostic. Complete saved evidence and strict successor controls remain required before the second application.
limitations: Partial technical database-correspondence diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Completion of these scoped checks is not whole-record scientific approval, reference-snippet coverage, generated-page validation, final corpus QC or campaign completion.

Six reference populations reproduce: Akkermansia muciniphila by species name, 4983 genomes/fraction 1.0; Bacteroides ovatus by species ID, 3107/0.99; B. thetaiotaomicron 1011/0.99; Bifidobacterium adolescentis 599/1.0; Escherichia coli 166397/1.0; Roseburia intestinalis 78/1.0. Rounded fractions of 0.99 are not unanimity or exact recoverable numerators. These populations are not experimental stock counts, inoculum ratios, abundance estimates or identity probabilities.

Blautia obeum retains both intestinalis/obeum alternatives; Faecalibacterium prausnitzii retains longum/prausnitzii/prausnitzii_D; Lactobacillus johnsonii retains johnsonii/sp945980025/sp947171515. These ordered native name ambiguities do not select a study-stock genome. The unchanged DSM 24404 placeholder has a null native result and remains UNRESOLVED, without a guessed species or a biological/domain-absence claim.

The source names ten DSMZ stocks and reports 16S identity confirmation. That source attribution is distinct from an independent stock-sequence or GTDB assembly analysis, which was not performed. Source stock names, collection identifiers, canonical species labels and prior notes remain unchanged.

The original ten-stock conditioned-medium panel, the later nine-species model after Roseburia exclusion, two-to-four-species validation co-cultures and the E. coli/B. ovatus invasion assays remain distinct. This work does not restore the previously removed gLV or invasion graph nodes or create member-to-node links.

The one COMMUNITY_LEVEL conditioned-medium node, absent participating_taxa and zero directed edges remain unchanged. Negative endpoint-density effects do not uniquely identify competition, toxins or a mediator; growth rate and final density are distinct. The ninety donor-acceptor conditions and 60% fresh/40% spent YCFA ratio remain literal source context.

The source phrase '8 mL flasks' does not establish an 8 mL working volume. Finding 2887 remains outside this correction; no claim is made that uninspected supplementary material lacks the quantity. Prior partial-review findings 2232/2233 concerning roles and an unpinned data resource remain unresolved. Historical caption and model-size discrepancies are not resolved by taxonomy.

DNA-qPCR relative frequencies are not direct viable-cell counts. Model predictions, observed co-culture/invasion outcomes and any in-vivo or pathogen inference remain distinct. No mechanism, biological role or cultivation recommendation is added.

Examination covered the whole current record, the previous partial metadata assessment and ledger, the current renderer guard and selected retained primary Methods/Results passages. No fresh full scientific paper review, separate supplementary inspection, figure-pixel audit, pinned repository snapshot, stock sequence or study-assembly verification was performed.

Historical missing-crosswalk notes and the October partial assessment remain unchanged evidence of their earlier scope. Their historical unresolved mapping statements are not rewritten or promoted to current scientific clearance. Original scientific findings, ledgers and issue dispositions remain preserved.

Source reporting and binding ran locally at 9bf78f54f83f88f954a309f351d862b4e0495c7a with preparation files disclosed. The isolated M5 stage and application began clean at e4dc49afd89482371a84ea71829eee6e27d94a1d, with frozen offline dependencies and native Python 3.13.2. Later gates correctly observe the applied record. The native status log processed ten taxa while its actual event records nine changed statuses.

Crosswalk SHA-256 is 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd; file mtime does not identify its upstream release. Local NCBITaxon/ENVO/GO readiness and identity observations retain actual stat-based provenance, without an invented full-database hash. Native terms reports Validation passed without an assertion denominator. Strict successor and composed renderer/caller checks remain separate follow-up work.

records.label: Six species-reference mappings and three preserved name-route ambiguities

evidence.locator: Retained main text line 75: Bacteria and growth conditions, DSMZ roster, conditioned-medium preparation, co-culture/invasion and qPCR Methods; exact primary_locators retained in captured source metadata
evidence.summary: The inspected source passages name the ten DSMZ stocks and report 16S confirmation, while distinguishing the original panel from subsequent modeling and assays. They do not independently assign each study stock to a GTDB genome or identify the molecular cause of each conditioned-medium effect.

evidence.locator: Selected taxonomy indices 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9: full native_result, classify_status, lookup_indexes, crosswalk_rows and ncbi_identity_rows
evidence.summary: The pinned native resolver and current authority observations support six species-reference correspondences and three complete ambiguity sets. The name route for Akkermansia differs from the five exact-ID routes. No stock assembly or single choice within an ambiguity is established; index 7 remains outside the selected correction.

evidence.locator: Actual before/after, external reviewed candidate and receipt pins, complete captured inputs, six-block/nine-status native inline events and appended native sidecar
evidence.summary: The exact independently reviewed candidate was persisted on isolated M5. Only selected GTDB fields and two native events change; all ten stock identities, the null placeholder, source quotations, biological assertions and prior history remain unchanged.

evidence.locator: Immutable partial metadata assessment, role-metadata and repository-version findings; original batch 4 ledger and current tests/test_site_audit_fixes.py renderer contract are also bound inputs
evidence.summary: The earlier assessment explicitly excludes scientific/mechanistic certification. Its unresolved roles and repository provenance, the historical graph removals and the renderer's prohibition on inferred participant links remain preserved. This technical successor does not overwrite or reinterpret that assessment as a full review.

assessments.topic: Species descriptors retain distinct DSM stock and experimental contexts
assessments.summary: The selected existing species descriptors retain their source-supported stock identities and current authority ranks. Ten-stock, later nine-species model and separate assay contexts remain distinct. Source 16S attribution is not an independently verified study-stock genome correspondence.

assessments.topic: Six reference populations and three complete ordered ambiguities
assessments.summary: The actual native change reproduces all six reviewed reference blocks and the complete two-, three- and three-way ambiguity lists. The two rounded 0.99 populations remain non-unanimous; no stock-specific assignment is inferred. The unselected DSM 24404 descriptor remains null/UNRESOLVED.

assessments.topic: Exact bounded application preserves scientific and historical scope
assessments.summary: The accepted candidate, actual receipt and sidecar bind the nine changed descriptors and two native events. Eight scoped commands passed on actual bytes, including a one-file strict check with zero errors. Original biology, earlier findings and the prior partial review remain unchanged; strict saved-successor and composed renderer controls are subsequent acceptance steps, not assumed results.
